per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Pay-as-you-go account creation must complete within 5 minutes for the majority of users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: System shall let customers register on the website as a "pay as you go" user in under 5 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Unlimited-subscription account creation may take longer but should complete within 10 minutes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: System shall let customers register on the website as a "unlimited movie subscriber" user in under 10 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Account creation must be accomplishable within a maximum of four separate pages/steps.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: After login, a user must be able to begin streaming their purchased movie within two clicks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Interactive actions like logging in or opening a page should respond within 5 seconds to avoid user frustration.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Login authentication must complete within 5 seconds (end-to-end) under normal conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'System shall let existing customers log into the website with their email address and password in under 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: End-to-end purchase-to-play for a pre-selected movie should be possible in about 3 minutes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Initial video start (time-to-first-frame/startup) and buffering should not exceed 10 seconds under typical conditions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The site must degrade gracefully on slow connections: provide lower-quality stream options and clear, non-technical messages instead of an indefinite spinner.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The site must avoid adding unnecessary overhead (heavy images, autoplay videos, excessive redirects) that worsens performance on slow home connections.
The user interface must be simple enough that at least 90% of novice users (non-technical) can create an account and watch a clip without assistance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Run observable usability tests where non-technical users attempt to create an account and watch a clip; majority success indicates usability is acceptable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Registration flows must be both fast and clear; visibility of steps and minimal steps should be enforced to prevent confusion even if the flow is quick.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Service availability must meet approximately 99.5% uptime.
When the site is unavailable, present a clear, friendly downtime message including reason and estimated time to recovery; provide refund or compensation options if the user paid for content.
Successful payment should reliably trigger playback; payment-completed-but-player-stuck scenarios must be prevented or automatically remediated.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Pages must avoid clutter: minimize intrusive ads and prevent autoplay media that leads users to immediately close the tab.
Pre-paid card redemption flow must be simpler and faster than credit-card payment flow (minimal steps: enter code and play).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Password complexity requirements must be reasonable for non-technical users; provide alternatives such as magic links or gentle help prompts rather than strict complexity rules that cause drop-off.
Interactive click latency must feel instantaneous: users should not experience a frozen UI when re-clicking; guard against duplicate requests and visible feedback should appear immediately.
